output.note: APR solved by bracketed bisection on the Appendix J (b)(8) general equation. The odd-days fraction is priced at simple interest, (1 + f*i), per (b)(6); only the integer count of full unit-periods is compounded. A rate is reported only when a sign-change bracket was established; otherwise apr_pct is null and APR_NOT_BRACKETED or APR_DID_NOT_CONVERGE is raised. Input APOR separately for QM spread test.
output.regulatory_basis: Reg Z Appendix J, 12 CFR 1026 Appendix J (general actuarial equation)
